bio.text: Vivek Ramaswamy, a Republican, is a candidate for Governor of Ohio in the November 3, 2026 election, on a joint ticket with Robert McColley.
He was born in Cincinnati, Ohio, and graduated from Harvard University in 2007 with a degree in biology and from Yale Law School in 2013.
Ramaswamy founded the biotech holding company Roivant Sciences in 2014, served as its chief executive until January 2021, and co-founded the investment firm Strive Asset Management in 2022.
He was a candidate in the 2024 Republican presidential primary.

sources.title: Vivek Ramaswamy officially launches bid for Ohio governor in 2026
